name: Mandarin Oriental Punta Negra, Mallorca
positioning: Coastal Mandarin Oriental resort in Calvià, Mallorca, with casitas along the shoreline, a spa and several restaurants
best_for: Travelers who want a Mediterranean coastal base with a spa
Food-minded guests who like a choice of restaurants on site

facts.text: The hotel is located within Calvià, in Mallorca.
The hotel is close to the Portals port.
The casitas are rooted in the fishermen's houses that once shaped the shoreline.
The spa has seven indoor and two outdoor treatment rooms.
Two outdoor swimming pools overlook the bay of Punta Negra.
The spa's Heat and Water Experiences include a hydromassage pool.
The spa's Heat and Water Experiences include a cold plunge.
Leppoc serves Mediterranean and Spanish Riviera flavours.
Jacinta is a Mexican restaurant specialising in artisanal tacos, tostadas and tamales.
Sobretaula is an oceanside terrace serving Spanish tapas.

highlights.text: Leña Mallorca is a steakhouse featuring open-fire cooking.
Leña Mallorca offers a display of dry aged meats.
Leña is chef Dani García's steakhouse concept.
The spa offers a signature Essence of Mallorca ritual.
The three-bedroom penthouse suite has a private rooftop pool.
The Deluxe Garden Room with Plunge Pool features a private plunge pool.

considerations.text: Matsuhisa is listed with an October opening.
Tennis and padel courts are located within walking distance of the hotel.
Cancellations of spa appointments made within 24 hours of the scheduled time incur a 100% charge.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
